title: He moved to the US at 12. In 2026, he became mayor of New Jersey's largest township.

sources.text: Parsippany Township - Mayor Pulkit Desai official bio
Global Indian - Indian-origin mayors taking charge of America's cities in 2026

caption:
He moved to the US at 12. In 2026, he became mayor of New Jersey's largest township.

Born in India and raised in the United States from age 12, Desai became the first Indian-American mayor of Morris County's largest municipality, narrowly defeating the Republican incumbent.

He won the mayoral race by a margin narrow enough that the incumbent legally contested it - and lost that challenge too.

Desai's path - India to the Marines to cybersecurity to the mayor's office - is local government increasingly shaped by people who started somewhere else entirely.
